title: Partner integrations
descriptionFoods: Delivery partners and POS / marketplace orders per location. Without credentials everything runs in sandbox — nothing is sent.
descriptionRealty: Property portal feeds per office. Without portal credentials feeds are sandbox previews — nothing is sent or published.
sandboxBanner: Sandbox is clearly separate from live: a connection only goes live when its credentials are complete, a connection test passes and you switch it to live.
notFetched: Not fetched by the portal yet
webhookUrl: Webhook URL (give this to the partner)
feedUrl: Feed URL (give this to the portal — keep it private)
uberUnavailable: Uber Direct isn’t offered in {country} — deliveries use your own drivers.
readOnly: You can see these connections; changing them needs the “Manage connections” permission.
saved: Saved. New credentials always start in sandbox until tested.

portals.noOffices: No offices in the countries this portal serves.
portals.configureHint: Configure portal credentials per office in Connections.
portals.exported: Export finished: {ok} delivered or in the feed, {invalid} need fixes. {transmitted, select, true {Sent to the portal.} other {Nothing was transmitted (sandbox).}}
portals.errorsEmpty: Every opted-in listing passes the portal checks.
portals.removedNote: Withdrawn, sold and let listings are removed from portals automatically.

reason.credentials_saved: Sandbox — credentials saved; switch to live after a successful test
reason.test_failed: Last connection test failed — test again
reason.awaiting_fetch: Feed URL ready — waiting for the portal to fetch it

requirements.uber_direct: Requires an Uber Direct business account (Uber Direct dashboard → Developer) with API access for your country.
requirements.deliverect: Requires Deliverect partner credentials (staging first; production after Deliverect certification) and the customer’s Deliverect account and location.
requirements.rightmove: Rightmove must set up a Real Time Datafeed network for BranchHarbor and issue the network ID and client certificate.
requirements.idealista: idealista must enable feed import for your professional account and be given the feed URL below.
requirements.reso_xml: The portal (for example Zillow Listing Feeds) must approve the feed for your brokerage and be given the feed URL below.
requirements.reaxml: realestate.com.au / Domain must enable REAXML import for your agency and be given the feed URL below.

fields.posInjection: Send accepted BranchHarbor orders to the POS
fields.marketplaceOrders: Receive marketplace orders (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, DoorDash, Just Eat)

fieldHelp.customerId: Shown in the Uber Direct dashboard (Developer tab)
fieldHelp.webhookSigningKey: Uber Direct dashboard → Webhooks; the webhook URL is shown below
fieldHelp.feeMode: Absorb: customers pay your zone fee and you pay Uber. Pass on: customers pay the Uber quote.
fieldHelp.webhookSecret: In staging, Deliverect signs with the channel link ID
fieldHelp.networkId: Issued by the Rightmove Data Feed team for BranchHarbor as your feed provider
fieldHelp.baseUrl: Leave empty for production (https://adfapi.rightmove.co.uk); Rightmove issues separate test URLs
fieldHelp.customerCode: Your idealista professional account code (for example ilc…)
fieldHelp.feedId: The ID the portal gives your feed when it approves it (Zillow Listing Feed, syndicator, MLS)
fieldHelp.agentId: The agency ID issued by realestate.com.au or Domain

testResult.feed_ready: Feed ready: {included} listings included, {excluded} need fixes. Give the feed URL to the portal.
testResult.sample: Sample data: no partner is contacted. Connect the API to test real credentials.

menuSandbox: Sandbox: menu snapshot built, nothing sent to Deliverect
busySandboxOn: Sandbox: busy mode recorded, marketplaces not paused
